<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state(f):
    out={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
        if n['color']=='N' and r0>=50: out['robotN']=(c0,c1)
        if n['color']=='W' and r0<=19: out['upperW']=(c0,c1)
        if n['color']=='W' and 24<=r0 and r1<=39: out['midW']=(c0,c1,n['pixels'])
        if n['color']=='W' and r0>=44: out['lowW']=(c0,c1)
    return out
print('BASE',state(current_frame))
seq=[{'action':'MOUSE','row':25,'col':1},
     {'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':1},
     {'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':1},
     {'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':1}]
for a in seq:
    r=action([a])
    print('after',a['row'],state(current_frame),'noimp',last_action_result.get('no_impact'),'lvl',last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('no_impact'):
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
